ranking_method: priority_score is a 0-100 judgment combining information gain, mission value, falsification cost, reversibility, risk, dependency burden, and reuse value; assumptions remain explicit in each task.

items.title: Implement the minimum durable kernel and machine-readable registries
items.acceptance: Zero-dependency CLI validates Governor/state invariants, selects work deterministically, records allowed transitions, supports recovery, and passes tests.
items.reversal_condition: Replace the storage layer only when measured scale or concurrency makes versioned files inadequate.

items.title: Build a current primary-source opportunity register
items.acceptance: Five or more candidates are ranked with current primary evidence, economics, uncertainty, risks, falsification and reopening criteria.
items.reversal_condition: Re-rank when material source, market, cost, or policy evidence changes.

items.title: Audit repository, runtime, deployment, credential, wallet, and persistent-state reality
items.acceptance: Observed state and absent capabilities are documented without reading or exposing secret values.
items.reversal_condition: Repeat after material repository, runtime, deployment, or credential-boundary changes.

items.title: Independently review minimal kernel design and prior branch artifacts
items.acceptance: Review identifies required schemas, invariants, commands, tests, recovery behavior, and unsafe or premature scope.
items.reversal_condition: Re-review after any material architecture or permission expansion.

items.title: Verify kernel, persist audit evidence, and complete bootstrap transition
items.acceptance: Tests and validation pass, audit gaps are persisted, and the BOOTSTRAP to DISCOVERY transition has evidence.
items.reversal_condition: Return to BOOTSTRAP if state cannot be validated or resumed from a fresh process.

items.title: Execute the cheapest high-information opportunity falsification experiment
items.acceptance: A bounded reproducible experiment records prediction, method, evidence, observed result, uncertainty, decision, and next action without capital or external writes.
items.reversal_condition: Replace the selected experiment if current evidence changes the opportunity ranking before execution.
